esp32.detail: 3 pins wired; Grove Line Finder v1.1 needs at least 4.75 V, so it is powered from 5 V. U2.SIG → D25 (GPIO25). Added a 10 kΩ / 15 kΩ divider on SIG: it swings to 5 V, and the D25 pin takes 3.3 V at most. Added the grove_line_finder.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports a black line when the sensor is over one: passes

pico.detail: 3 pins wired; Grove Line Finder v1.1 needs at least 4.75 V, so it is powered from 5 V. U2.SIG → GP2 (GPIO2). Added a 10 kΩ / 15 kΩ divider on SIG: it swings to 5 V, and the GP2 pin takes 3.3 V at most. Added the grove_line_finder.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports a black line when the sensor is over one: passes
